thread:
Alex: Heads-up: Prospect 'Nautilus' asked for a staged cutover from CompetitorX. Key asks: prompt parity, token billing reconciliation, and on-prem fallback. Can we triage blockers?
Jess: Quick clarifier — do they expect identical API surface for prompt templates or just output parity? Sales said 'minimal client changes'.
Samir: From POC side: three blockers I see: 1) tokenization differences causing output drift; 2) they rely on session state via a custom header; 3) enterprise requires FIPS KMS + audit log proof.
Olga: Tokenization shim idea: normalize whitespace + map control tokens before hitting model. Not perfect but reduces drift. For session state we can honor an X-Client-Session header and do sticky routing on Dedicated. Ryan, can you confirm KMS/HSM support?
deploy-bot: Deploy request created: presales/nautilus-shim v0.1 -> staging. CI queued.
Alex: Pricing question — they want delta if we run quantized model vs CompetitorX. Samir, can you rough out $/1k tokens and latency tradeoffs?
Samir: Quick estimate: for 8k seq workload, quantized on Dedicated is ~40% cheaper per-token vs CompetitorX public GPUs (assumes similar batching). Latency: +10-25% depending on batch size. I'll drop numbers in the shared sheet.
Jess: Security checklist from the customer: HSM-backed keys, SOC2 evidence, role separation, and IP allowlist for staging. Olga, can you confirm what we can provide on Private/Dedicated?
Olga: We have SOC2 Type II docs. Private supports KMS/HSM keywrap and allowlisting. Need legal sign-off on network egress policy. I'll attach the docs in the POC folder.
Alex: Proposed POC acceptance criteria: 1) Top-1 intent parity >=95% on their eval set. 2) 95th p95 latency within 20% of CompetitorX. 3) Billing reconciliation script + sample report. Target timeline: 2-week POC.
Samir: 2 weeks is doable if they provide eval set + staging creds by Monday. Action items: Samir -> smoke tests & cost sheet; Jess -> coordinate creds + client comms; Olga -> security docs + legal ping; Alex -> confirm eval set and pricing sign-off.
Jess: I'll ping them for eval set now. Also note: legal flagged data retention — they want 90d retention and no training.
Alex: Good catch. We'll confirm no-training option and add to contract addendum. I'll update thread after legal confirms.
Olga: Uploading SOC2 & KMS integration notes to the POC folder: https://redwood.internal/presales/nautilus/poc-docs
Samir: Smoke test snippet for shim (drop into staging):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Client-Session: 12345" \
  -d '{"prompt":"<eval prompt>","max_tokens":512}' \
  https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/v1/nautilus-shim/generate
```
Alex: Thanks — I'll circulate acceptance criteria to the customer and ask for the eval set deadline.
Jess: :thumbsup:
Alex: Marking this thread as presales-triage for follow-up.
